For Maxim, the Russian-born lead actor, the situation causes inner turmoil that intensifies with the onset of the invasion of Ukraine. Multifaceted and complex questions in a burning contemporary drama.

credits.title: The Unthinkable
credits.overview: Sweden faces a mysterious attack while Alex tries to reunite with his youth love, Anna.

credits.title: Tweener
credits.overview: 13-year-old best friends Jaana and Bettan channel their emotions atop the wrestling mat.

credits.overview: Two best friends, Alex and Valentina, dream about conquering the world together. But when they go to Los Angeles and audition for the same part, they start competing about the big breakthrough. Eventually Alex has to ask herself what she’s willing to do to achieve success.

credits.overview: Eric and Elin reminisce about the dark, magical summer when they first met. They were just kids and their parents, Linda and Peter, were drug addicts. During a few violent but beautiful months...

credits.title: The Unemployed
credits.overview: The Swedish unemployment has reached the criminal realms. We meet characters that have to fight for their lives in order to finish their work shift in one piece. An action satire of the Swedish labor market.

credits.title: Vaskduellen

credits.title: Niggerball
credits.overview: A conversation between two friends on why you cannot say "niggerball" gets out of hand and ends in an orgy of misunderstandings.
